name: kgpl-scan-suite
description: KGPL Scan Suite - static PWA served as BSP ZSOL_SCAN_SUITE. No UI5 build; build just stages the shipped files into dist/ for fiori deploy.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html manifest.json html5-qrcode.min.js dist/
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && npx -p @sap/ux-ui5-tooling@1 fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml --yes --testMode
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -p @sap/ux-ui5-tooling@1 fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml --yes
